notes:
Inbound from product contact (Head of Search, Jenna Ortiz). Using internal Alfresco+GDrive doc store; want to upgrade search for customer support/legal ops. Interested in hosted API for fast self-serve POC. Key ask: embeddings + cheap reranking layer to boost relevance for short queries (2-6 tokens).

Call highlights (03/11): 
- Jenna: "need something that just works — low ops, low cost to start". SMB budget constraints but will pay if measurable reduction in time-to-answer.
- Current infra: extracts docs to S3 daily; thinking to run embeddings into Pinecone for now. Wants opinion on vector DB tradeoffs (Pinecone vs managed Redis vs PG vector extensions).
- Traffic: expect ~3k queries/day in POC, spiky during business hours (~250 q/hr). Latency target: 100-200ms for top-k retrieval, end-to-end 600-800ms with reranker (acceptable).
- Models: leaning toward open-source embedding model (small) to cut costs; asked about Redwood model catalog, default embedding models available on hosted API and any throughput guidance.
- Reranking: open to lightweight cross-encoder on small subset (top 20) — wants cost estimate per 1k queries.
- Security: SOC2 baseline sufficient; legal asked about audit logs and retention controls (30/90/365 day options). No air-gapped requirement.
- Roadmap: if POC hits KPIs, pilot for support team (est ~6-10 seats) by Q3.

AE notes / follow-ups: 
- Send self-serve account + 90-day trial token; attach quickstart notebook that wires S3 -> embeddings -> Pinecone -> Redwood hosted API rerank call.
- Ask devs to supply small sample of production-ish queries + doc set (anonymized) for eval; put in Drive link.
- Prepare rough cost model: tokens + embedding units + reranker compute.
- Provide short doc on vector DB pros/cons for SMB (latency, managed ops, cost tiers).

Internal: SE Priya requested to prep two variants for demo: (A) small-embedding + approximate ANN (lower cost) and (B) higher-quality embedding + cross-encoder rerank. Include measured latency and cost per 1k q.

Staging notes: still early; contact rate high but technical validation required. Legal team will require DPA before paid conversion.
